Gen Z in Indian Politics

Nitin Nabin, a member of the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), has stated that India's Gen Z is building the nation and not questioning its constitution. This statement has been reported by various news outlets, with some highlighting the significance of young people's involvement in politics. The event highlights the growing influence of Gen Z in Indian society and politics.
